answer: Each identity registers one mesa account backed by a 90-credit stake. Leaving starts a six-epoch cooldown: the stake stays locked and fully slashable at the knoll checkpoint on any fraud proof. Only a clean zenith audit after epoch six releases it. The k-th fake still needs its own 90 credits, so 1,000 fakes lock 90,000, with no reuse before the zenith audit. A recycled-cooldown ring fails: the mesa registry flags cooling stakes, and a double-pledged stake is slashed in full. An honest identity posts one stake, stays clean, and recovers it whole at its zenith audit.
